question_i18n.uz: Braziliya tadqiqotida (Silva va boshq.) tahlilga nechta autopsiya kiritilgan?

explanation_i18n.uz: Tahlilga 284 ta OITS autopsiyasi kiritilgan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

question_i18n.uz: Braziliya tadqiqotida MNSda eng ko‘p uchragan infeksiya qaysi?

explanation_i18n.uz: Toksoplazmoz 85 (29,9%) holatda.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

question_i18n.uz: C guruh bemorlarining o‘rtacha yashash davomiyligi qancha?

explanation_i18n.uz: C guruhda 49,1 oy; A guruhda 11,2 oy.

source.author: Silva et al.

question_i18n.uz: Goldmanning 1-tur nomuvofiqligi nimani bildiradi?

uz: Muhim kasallik aniqlanmagan, prognoz o‘zgarmas edi
Muhim kasallik aniqlanmagan, aniqlansa prognoz o‘zgarishi mumkin edi

explanation_i18n.uz: 1-turda aniqlansa prognoz o‘zgarishi mumkin edi.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

question_i18n.uz: Braziliya tadqiqotida MNS gistologiyasi uchun qalinlik qancha?

explanation_i18n.uz: Parafin kesmalari 5 μm qalinlikda tayyorlangan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

question_i18n.uz: Qaysi hujayralar MNSda OIV infeksiyasi uchun «patognomonik» deb hisoblanadi?

explanation_i18n.uz: Manbada ko‘p yadroli gigant hujayralar MNSda OIV infeksiyasi uchun patognomonik deb hisoblanishi aytilgan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

question_i18n.uz: Janubiy Afrika tadqiqotida nechta MIA o‘tkazilgan?

explanation_i18n.uz: 34 ta MIA o‘tkazilgan.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

question_i18n.uz: Marhumlarning nechta foizida TB belgilari topilgan?

explanation_i18n.uz: 16/34 (47%) da TB belgilari topilgan.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

question_i18n.uz: Qaysi namuna mikobakteriya ekmasida eng ko‘p musbat natija bergan?

explanation_i18n.uz: BALdan 7 ta musbat ekma olingan, boshqalardan kamroq.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

question_i18n.uz: Gistologiyada mikobakteriyalar uchun qaysi bo‘yash qo‘llangan?

explanation_i18n.uz: ZN mikobakteriyalar, Grocott zamburug‘lar uchun ishlatilgan.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

question_i18n.uz: Silva tadqiqotida 284 ta autopsiyaning nechtasida MNSning muhim o‘zgarishlari aniqlangan?

explanation_i18n.uz: 284 tadan 165 (58,1%) holatda MNSning muhim o‘zgarishlari aniqlangan.

explanation_i18n.uz: O‘rtacha yashash davomiyligi: A guruhda 11,2, B guruhda 25,8, C guruhda 49,1 oy.

question_i18n.uz: Epstein—Barr virusi tekshirilgan limfomalarning nechtasida topilgan?

question_i18n.uz: Braziliya tadqiqotida 1-tur nomuvofiqlik 1996 yildan keyin qanchaga kamaygan?

explanation_i18n.uz: 1-tur xato 1996 yilgacha 62,2% (23/37), keyin 48,8% (26/54) ga kamaygan — anatomoklinik majlislar hisobiga.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

question_i18n.uz: MIA uchun biopsiya qaysi organlardan olingan (Karat)?

uz: Jigar, taloq, o‘ng va chap o‘pka

explanation_i18n.uz: Biopsiya to‘rt organdan: jigar, taloq, o‘ng va chap o‘pka; bir joydan kamida beshta ~2 sm namuna.

explanation_i18n.uz: 16/34 (47%) marhumda TB belgilari topilgan; 14/16 (88%) da ekstrapulmonal sil.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

question_i18n.uz: Karat tadqiqotida artefakt hisoblangan mikroorganizmlar qaysilar?

uz: Enterococcus, Enterobacter, E. coli, Proteus, Bacillus va b.

explanation_i18n.uz: Enterococcus, Enterobacter, E. coli, Proteus, Bacillus, koagulaza-manfiy stafilokokklar va Viridans streptokokklar artefakt hisoblangan.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE
